column1: # One row per outstanding job. Columns (tab-separated): model, datasets, GPU memory needed in GB, status, note.

# status "ready": run it. "ready_gated": run it, but its weights are gated: the owner has accepted the licence and downloads them to HF_HOME with their own token first (prefetch.py never touches them).
# "done": finished and ingested, do not rerun. "blocked": do not run on the cluster (see the note). Source of truth for what each model runs: experiments/paper1/panel.py.
# Qwen/Qwen3-8B finished on the Mac (a run directory is never continued on another platform). Models finished elsewhere are not listed.
